draftBody:
Dear Aditya,

Thank you for your kind message and for your interest in having Dr. Denis Mukwege participate in Technex'27 at IIT (BHU) Varanasi. We appreciate the warm invitation and the distinguished legacy of your annual Techno-Management Fest.

To ensure we can properly review and forward your invitation to Dr. Mukwege's team, could you kindly share a few additional details: a formal invitation letter on institutional letterhead, the expected format and duration of Dr. Mukwege's participation, the organizing institutions and key partners involved, and any logistical arrangements being offered (travel, accommodation, visa support, etc.).

This information will allow us to assess the request appropriately and pass it along to the relevant team members.

Thank you again for thinking of Dr. Mukwege, and we wish you every success in the planning of Technex'27.

With warm regards,
The Panzi Foundation Team
